title: 2026-11-13 — A master row's `verified` evidence cites lines no sweep re-points

data.head: ## 2026-11-13 — A master row's `verified` evidence cites lines no sweep re-points

body: Since the masters became rows, a row holds no line citation in its text, so a site-sweep pattern on `path.rs:N` never fires its control over them and reads nothing. But a row's `verified` metadata (`rec.py get` prints it under the cells) still quotes `at: {path}:{lines}` evidence from the tree it was verified on. Neither the citation sweep nor the cascade sweep reads that cell, so a chunk that moves code those lines name leaves the evidence pointing at the old lines with no tool flagging it. When a chunk restructures a file, read the rows its change-pattern hits with `rec.py get` and check their `verified` coordinates by hand; the report names any that moved.

A behaviour-preserving restructure of three functions to bring their cognitive complexity under 15: the engine's click handler (97 to 2), the driver session's command dispatch (32 to 1) and the Dioxus document's UI graph builder (50 to 4).
The click handler now walks through one private function per element arm (checkbox, radio, summary, select, option, label, link, file input, the element match and the walk itself); the label arm still re-dispatches the click to its bound control; the double-click dispatch and the focus clear stay in the handler.
The driver's command dispatch is now one match with one private function per verb (snapshot, click, type with its acting step, press, advance, scroll, screenshot, graph); the command span, its fields, the target checks and the refusals are unedited.
The UI graph builder now splits into private functions for state readings, node handlers, handler writes, node reads and graph states, still compiled under the accessibility gate.
One new integration check of click default actions was added, six cases in both layout modes; no public symbol, span field, refusal cause, verb, dependency or capability was added, removed or retired.
Measured: every gate green, CI green 17 of 17, coverage floors held (driver 98.01, dioxus-native-dom 90.09, test harness 95.74 percent).

decision/one-span-per-command and decision/hosted-call-through-session-run: command execution was restructured beneath the session's run, which stays its sole caller; the rule still holds.

decision/driver-emits-no-event, decision/driver-library-installs-no-subscriber, decision/driver-spans-carry-no-content and decision/command-span-no-call-content: rules over the driver's command execution, which was restructured with no event, subscriber or span field added.

The graph answer (contract/graph-answer/shape, contract/graph-answer/content, contract/command-answer/graphed, decision/graph-answer-never-logged, contract/command-span/graph): the graph builder and the driver's graph arm were split into helper functions, its shape and content unchanged.
decision/state-registry-holds-no-values and decision/no-state-page-skips-registry: rules over the graph builder's reading of the state registry, now in its own helper.
decision/reached-record-ids-and-events-only: the graph builder's handler and dispatch reading of the reached record moved into helpers.

contract/page-events/checkbox-change, contract/page-events/radio-change and contract/page-events/single-change: the click handling that dispatches the change events on a checkbox and a radio moved into per-arm functions; behaviour unchanged, now also exercised by the new check.
decision/checks-silent: a new silent check of click default actions joins the silent checks; it holds no tracing, print, env read or sink.
contract/snapshot-node/clickable and contract/snapshot-text/clickable: what a click reaches is decided by the engine's click walk, restructured with behaviour unchanged.

The select rows (decision/select-chosen-set-never-logged, decision/select-list-label-never-logged, contract/multiple-select-form-entries/chosen-option, contract/snapshot/multiple-select-value): the select and option click arms and the driver's type step on a select were moved into named functions with no log site added.

decision/session-logs-carry-no-page-content and decision/shot-image-leaves-only-in-answer: the driver's typing and screenshot arms (the masked typed text, the crop and its error map) were moved into named functions with no log site added.
decision/no-file-loads-from-non-file-documents: link navigation on click, which resolves the href against the document URL, moved into its own function unchanged.
escher's telemetry sink, its log line format, scrub set, target allowlist, RUST_LOG handling, resource keys and panic hook: no sink, scrub or subscriber code changed.
The MCP tool_call span, its ending and the refusal cause names: no cause, tool or ending was added, renamed or moved.
The cold-agent pipe and the agent-run harness: their events, verdict fields, counted verbs, kept checks and transcripts are not reached.
escher-session's commands, exit codes, stderr, coverage role line, host wire, recording directory and session lifecycle: unchanged.
Metric emission, metrics exporters, telemetry backends and WPT score publishing: the session adds no metric, exporter or backend.
Script error capture, the window error event and the WPT report: not reached.
CI integration rows (artifacts, workflows, cleanup, package-install diagnostics): no workflow or CI script changed; the coverage floors held.
Engine and escher tracing gating by cargo feature: no tracing call or feature gate was added, removed or moved.

body_fields.value: A pointer click on a button of any type or an input of type submit, reset or button focuses it, submits the form owner when it is a submit button and ends the walk, in every document; a click on another non-interactive element clears focus, leaving the focused reading the root element, never none.
body_fields.because: The chunk met that a click no element takes clears focus and the focused reading then falls back to the root element, never none, so a check asserting no focus reads red on a correct engine; the row says only that focus clears and must state what the reading becomes.

body_fields.value: The engine's click default action is restructured under the ceiling with upstream's arms, a hand re-apply owed when an upstream sync edits an arm; every other engine function over the ceiling is left.
body_fields.because: The chunk restructured the engine's click default action, upstream's arms included, under the ceiling by an operator-chosen exception at the price of a hand re-apply on upstream syncs, so the ceiling row must name that exception to the engine functions it otherwise leaves as they are.

body_fields.reason: The chunk restructured handle_click, Session::execute and DioxusDocument::graph with behaviour unchanged and added no user-facing surface, region, verb, field or provider (fct-xhynuok7, fct-v6e35mmt, fct-pseqlxla); the click_default_actions check boots a plain HTML page with a navigation recorder, not a stand boot or a network provider, so decision/load-page-only-network and every other row of layout-templates stays true, and D-layout-surface does not fire.

The chunk is a behaviour-preserving restructure of handle_click, Session::execute and DioxusDocument::graph into private functions, with no span field, refusal cause, verb, key name, carrier, log field, env read, listener or dependency added (fct-v6e35mmt, fct-wnycnlt5, fct-xhynuok7), the command span still opened in run with its eight fields recorded where they were (fct-xhynuok7), and the new click_default_actions check silent with no tracing, print, env read or sink (fct-qn3d2dtx, fct-pseqlxla); every picked obs-plan row, the stale-marked span, answer, page-event, silent-check and no-subscriber rows included, stays true, and the report carries no task fact for obs-plan.

body_fields.because: The report measures the row's why false, the URL resolver answering none for an unresolvable URL so that no resolver panics, while the rule still holds, so the why must drop its false clause, which is the whole cell.

body_fields.value: The engine's click handler is held below the ceiling, upstream's arms included, at the price of a hand re-apply when an upstream sync edits one of its arms.
body_fields.because: The chunk restructured the engine's click handler below the ceiling with upstream's arms on the operator's word, so the row's stance that engine functions over the ceiling are left as they are now holds one named exception.

body_fields.value: A control on a loop's advance step neutralises the step to the loop's exit rather than removing the line, since removing it loops forever.
body_fields.because: A remove-the-line control on a loop's advance hung the test binary, so the controlled-test convention now carries the loop-exit form as its named exception.

body_fields.promise: With no node focused, the harness's focused reading answers the root html element, never none, so a check that a click clears focus asserts the root element.
body_fields.because: The chunk met the engine's focus reading answering the root element when nothing is focused, a promise of the harness's focused reading that checks rely on and no row states.

body:
A behaviour-preserving restructure for cognitive load: the engine's click default-action handler, the driver's command executor and the Dioxus document's graph builder were each split into private per-arm functions, signatures, callers and behaviour unchanged.
Cognitive readings moved: the click handler 97 to 2, the command executor 32 to 1, the graph builder 50 to 4; every new private function reads 0 to 10.
No public symbol, span field, refusal cause, verb, key name, carrier, log field, env read, listener, dependency or unwrap/expect count was added or removed; the census of log and panic sites per file held equal.
One new silent integration check was added: click default actions (link navigation and fragment links, a hrefless link walking on to its label, an unmatched click clearing focus, a disabled submit stopping the walk, a label of a multiple select, a double click), in both layout modes.
Coverage readings moved with every per-crate floor held: escher-driver 98.04 to 98.01, dioxus-native-dom 86.71 to 90.09, blitz-test-harness 96.06 to 95.74.
The operator's standing word for this wrap: the security decision unresolvable-stylesheet-href-no-load holds a FALSE why, its resolver no longer panics, and must be mended by the shorter why or retired.

body_fields.what: the engine's click default actions — the click walk up the tree, focus clear, the double click, and per-element arms: checkbox and radio toggling with their change event, summary/details toggling, select and option choice, label re-dispatch to its bound control, link navigation by the resolved href, button click focus, file input dialog

the driver's command executor — the one match over verbs (snapshot, click, type including type on a select, key, advance of the virtual clock, scroll, screenshot in band, graph, lint, actions) under the one command span, feeding the session's bounded record of read ids
the graph answer builder of the Dioxus document — state readings, handlers per node, declared and confirmed writes from the signal registry and its dispatch record, reads per scope, the graph states
a new silent integration check of the engine's click default actions with a recording navigation provider, in the unpublished blitz-tests crate

body: decision/unresolvable-stylesheet-href-no-load: its why (resolution through the non-panicking resolver instead of the one that panics) is FALSE — the URL resolver answers none and never panics since the upstream take; its rule (no load, no render block) still holds; two leaves already state the truth; the shorter why or a retire is owed.

decision/engine-change-event-checkable: the checkbox and radio change dispatch moved into their own arm functions, behaviour unchanged; its verified evidence cites click-handler lines that now stand elsewhere (checkbox change at 951-954, radio if-not-was-checked at 995-1000); guard checkable_change_event unchanged and green.

decision/external-navigation-get-http-mailto and decision/external-navigation-schemes: link navigation on click moved into its own arm (resolve the href, navigate), unchanged; the new check asserts a link leaving the document navigates and a fragment link does not.

decision/button-click-focuses and decision/enter-activates-focused-control and decision/space-keyup-activates-focused-control: the click arms they reach (button, the walk, the focus clear) were split, behaviour unchanged.

decision/select-choice-one-write-path, decision/multiple-select-keys-and-clicks, decision/select-list-row-choice, decision/select-list-pointer-release-chooses: select and option click arms moved into their own functions, unchanged; the new check asserts a label of a multiple select focuses it and chooses nothing.

decision/one-command-span-per-call and decision/command-span-content-free and the driver-command-span contract items: the command span stays opened in the session's run with its eight fields recorded where they were; no field added.

decision/closed-driver-verb-schema, decision/single-validation-gate, decision/target-refusal-order, decision/closed-refusal-cause-set: the executor's verb match was split into one function per verb; no verb, cause or check order changed, the target check unedited.

decision/driver-type-on-select: the type verb's acting order (select focus or click, select-all and backspace, then typing that skips a leading space on a select) became a named step function, unchanged.
decision/advance-moves-virtual-clock-exactly and decision/time-moves-only-on-advance: the advance verb moved into its own function, unchanged.
decision/screenshot-in-band and decision/screen-pixels-in-band and contract/screenshot-answer/png: the screenshot verb with its crop and error map moved into its own function, unchanged.

decision/id-record-bounded-and-session-fed and decision/session-id-record-bounded and decision/no-node-id-between-calls: the snapshot and graph verbs still feed the session's bounded record of ids, now from their own functions.

decision/graph-answer-crossing, decision/graph-answer-unpaged, contract/graph-answer/nodes-states, contract/declared-write/event, contract/declared-write/target: the graph builder was split into state readings, handlers, writes, reads and states functions; the answer is unchanged.

decision/signal-registry-holds-no-state-value, decision/dispatch-recorded-only-with-signal-registry, decision/reached-handler-record-without-log: the graph builder now imports the registry's dispatch record privately; still compiled under the accessibility gate, no log added.

decision/driver-outcomes-never-logged, decision/accessible-names-not-logged, decision/stable-id-not-logged, decision/no-screen-content-in-logs: no log site added in any of the three changed components; the new check holds no tracing, print or env read.

MCP server and session socket transport rows, CLI flags, roles and exit codes, session errors: the transport, the wire and the command line are unedited.
Recording, recorded-check, cold-agent and agent-run rows: no recorder, replay or script changed.
Telemetry sink allowlist and log target rows: no sink, target or field changed.
WPT runner, CSS parse, stylesheet loading and serialization rows other than the stylesheet-href why above: the mutator and the document were proved unedited.
Stable element id derivation and snapshot text contract items: no id form, state word or field changed.

Restructured three functions toward a cognitive complexity of 15 with behaviour unchanged: the engine's click default actions (handle_click 97 to 2), the driver's command executor (Session::execute 32 to 1) and the Dioxus document's UI graph builder (DioxusDocument::graph 50 to 4), each split into private per-arm or per-step functions with signatures and callers kept.
handle_click is an engine function, restructured on the operator's word with upstream's arms included, so a later upstream sync that edits one of those arms must be re-applied by hand.
Added one new blitz-tests integration target, click_default_actions: six checks run in both layout modes (a link leaving the document navigates and a fragment link does not, a link with no href walks on to its label, a click no element takes clears focus, a disabled submit button stops the walk, a label of a multiple select focuses it and chooses nothing, two clicks with no time between them are one double click), over a hand-written recording NavigationProvider and an HtmlDocument wrapped by Harness::wrap with a VirtualClock; the check is silent (no tracing, print, env read or sink).
Measured: each new check red under its own mutation control (6 holds); coverage readings escher-driver 98.01 %, dioxus-native-dom 90.09 %, blitz-test-harness 95.74 %, every per-crate floor held; functions over 15 in the three files 6 to 3; CI green 17/17. No public symbol, dependency, span field, refusal cause, verb or schema changed; nothing retired.

the Dioxus document's UI graph — task state readings, node handlers and listeners from the vdom walk, declared and confirmed handler writes, the graph answer
